Cutout review: 9 pairs

Transparent WebP files ready for the site. Switch backgrounds to inspect the edges, and click any shoe to see it at 1:1 pixel size. Every pair below is used on the site.

01maroon-silver-boots.webp
836×1050px · 157 KB · from 1.jpg

The source photo had already been cut out once and pasted on white, leaving a pale rim around the edges. That rim is now removed. The two lace ends on the right and bottom were cut off by the original photo frame, so they end in a straight edge. I did not extend them.

Original photo
02airbrush-face-spider-lows.webp
1023×875px · 167 KB · from 2.jpg

Clean separation all round, including the gap between the two shoes. The soft shadow from the original white backdrop was removed rather than baked in, so it won’t look grey on dark pages.

Original photo
03cobra-airbrush-hightops.webp
1086×1116px · 270 KB · from 3.jpg

Clean, including the inside of the lace loops. The loose lace on the right runs off the original photo frame, so it ends in a straight edge. The source looks heavily sharpened, so edges are slightly crunchy at 1:1 (that’s in the photo, not the cutout).

Original photo
04tiger-print-boots.webp
551×550px · 63 KB · from 4.jpg

Clean edges. The clear plastic tag and its string are attached to the shoe in the photo, so I kept them. Low resolution source (735×810): sharp at medium size, soft if shown huge.

Original photo
05silver-turf-trainers.webp
606×653px · 78 KB · from 5.jpg

Clean edges, including the gap between the shoes. The coiled metal shoe trees are inside the shoes; removing them would mean inventing the shoe interior, so they stay. Low resolution source (735×727).

Original photo
06fur-chain-heels.webp
535×820px · 101 KB · from 7.jpg

Clean cut against the grey wall, including the gaps between the two shafts and inside both heel arches. Fur tips are kept soft rather than clipped, with no grey fringe. Chains, buckles, cross charms and stilettos are intact. Low resolution source (735×930).

Original photo
07collage-lace-up-boots.webp
696×694px · 132 KB · from 8.jpg

The source was already a rough cutout pasted on white. The white is gone and no pale rim is left. The dark line around the edge is the boot’s own edge paint and rubber sole, so it stays. Laces inside the curve are kept.

Original photo
08crackle-face-boots.webp
673×640px · 97 KB · from 9.jpg

Both tall laces and the lace loop are kept, with the background inside the loop removed. The table shadow under the soles is removed and the black outsole kept whole. Low resolution source (736×736).

Original photo
09pin-up-tattoo-hightops.webp
736×873px · 137 KB · from 10.jpg

Separated from a busy carpet and floor, including the carpet between the two shoes and inside the trailing lace loops. Both loose laces on the floor are kept. The lower shoe’s collar runs off the right edge of the original photo, so it ends in a straight edge there. Low resolution source (736×981).

Original photo
Method: BiRefNet segmentation, then removal of stray fragments, then edge colour decontamination so the old background colour doesn't bleed into edge pixels. Each image was checked at 4× zoom on dark, light and blue backgrounds. No colours were changed, nothing was upscaled, and no details were painted in. The shadow toggle is a preview of a shadow the site can add; it is not baked into the files.
